description: The unit battery (D-065 (4), D-069 item 14) and the battery role, tier 3 on integration.advanced (D-065 (5), plan v3 M6).

battery.bisection_max_runs.description: Most tier-3 runs one batch bisection may spend over the tips advanced since the last green tip (enough for 2^6 = 64 tips). When they run out first, battery.culprit names the batches still in doubt instead of one culprit.

battery.contract_test_globs.description: Test files that prove a unit's contract from the consumer's side; a unit's battery also runs those of the units that require it (P-12: the contract of the direct consumers).

battery.enabled.description: The battery role's on/off switch (D-065 (5), D-069 item 11). Off: `scripts/battery run` exits without reading a log or taking the lock, and no tier 3 runs. Switched on only by a config.changed event (scripts/config set).

battery.lock_lease_s.description: Lease of the battery lock from each take or renewal; an expired lock may be taken over. Renewed before every tier-3 run, so the role refuses to start unless it exceeds battery.tier3_timeout_s.

battery.lock_ref.description: Branch name of the battery lock in the forge (refs/heads/<name>), naming the lock owner; one holder runs the role until no newer integration tip is pending (D-065 (1)). A lock of its own, apart from train.lock_ref, so tier 3 never blocks a merge.

battery.producer.description: Producer name of every battery role event (battery.green, battery.red, battery.culprit, release.ready, engine.step.measured); part of each event id.

battery.project_tsconfig.description: The TypeScript project's own tsconfig (its compiler settings) that each unit's types project extends; the generated `paths` it extends in turn live wherever the addresses target writes them (TX32). OU-DECOUPLE F5 (D-113): the TypeScript product's folder is products/web.
battery.project_tsconfig.x-source: plan v3 §7.2; TX32 (the address map leaves the project tsconfig)

battery.step_prefix.description: Prefix of the engine.step.measured step names the battery role emits (battery:run, battery:tier3, battery:bisect).

battery.tier3_command.description: Tier-3 command, relative to the repository root, run on an integration tip (its sha is appended): the full battery with a fresh build cache, never cached, Chromium only and no Neon (D-065 (5), V7: WebKit and gate-db run only at release).

battery.tier3_log_chars.description: Tail of a red tier-3 run's output the role prints to its session log (the events carry the failing stages, never the log).

battery.tier3_timeout_s.description: Longest one tier-3 run may take before it counts as red (stage timeout).

battery.unit_log_lines.description: Lines of a failing battery step's output the report keeps.

battery.unit_producer.description: Producer name of the events a unit battery (scripts/unit-battery, tier 1) emits; the tier-3 battery role has its own, battery.producer.

battery.unit_step.description: Step name of a unit battery in engine.step.measured; each of its steps is <name>.<step>.

battery.unit_steps.description: The steps of a unit's battery (scripts/unit-battery <id>, tier 1): each takes the unit's files under its cwd that match include (globs, plus the values of include_entries) and no exclude; mode types writes a per-unit tsconfig ({project}) with the unit's TypeScript files and the step's globals, files passes them all ({files}), each runs the command once per file ({file}). A step with no file is skipped. Every step runs; the steps run concurrently. The engine's one step is its script tests; the TypeScript steps of products/web left with that product (OU-DECOUPLE F5, D-113; D-298), and a product that brings TypeScript back adds its own types and files steps.
battery.unit_steps.x-source: P-12; veto V5; plan v3 §4.2 item 6

battery.unit_time_limit.description: Longest wall time of one unit's battery (types, tests and contract).

battery.unit_types_dir.description: Directory, ignored by git, where the battery writes each unit's tsconfig for its types step.
battery.unit_types_dir.x-source: plan v3 §7.2 (one TypeScript project per unit)
